summary: Brookfield Corporation filed a Form 6-K announcing the full redemption of its Cumulative Redeemable Class A Preference Shares, Series 51 and 52, for cash on November 1, 2026. Series 51 shares will be redeemed at CAD 22.44 per share plus accrued dividends, while Series 52 shares redeem at CAD 22.00 per share, with holders of record as of October 15, 2026, receiving a final quarterly dividend of CAD 0.151250 on October 30, 2026. This is a capital return event to preference shareholders, effectively retiring the securities. The redemption is mandatory for holders, with no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for the actual redemption execution and the impact on Brookfield's capital structure.
